stances.summary: Defends prioritizing American interests as compatible with economic freedom

stances.summary: Explores economic measurement beyond GDP and standard metrics
stances.quote: Is Kansas Richer than Canada? with Jeff Reimer and Brian Dijkema (by Chris Griswold). Two writers travel to both sides of the border to understand what metrics can’t capture.
